name: Anne Consigny
bio: Anne Consigny is a French film and television actress, best known for her feature film roles of Françoise in "Je ne suis pas là pour être aimé" as well as Claude in "The Diving Bell and the Butterfly".

credits.overview: The comedy explores the clash of cultures between a French woman and a Quebecer, highlighting the complexities of language and cultural differences between families.

credits.title: Rodin and Michelangelo: The Song of the Statues
credits.overview: By filming the works of the two artists, Rodin and Michelangelo, from close up, *Le Chant des Statues* brings to life the dialogue between two giants of sculpture who, throughout the centuries, have ceaselessly vied with one another to breathe life into their depictions of the human form.
